lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Budget watchdog warns the cost of Ottawa’s borrowing goes beyond the deficit, Canada's National Observer reports.
Democrat Mary Peltola wins US Senate race in Alaska, beating incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan, The Associated Press reports.

Nvidia rejected Jensen Huang’s offer to return as CEO, putting to rest for now any possible reinstatement of the celebrated artificial intelligence billionaire and industry evangelist,, The Associated Press reports.
Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.

bds.h: White House pulls U.S. FDA nominee Heidi Overton after wavering support from Senate Republicans
bds.lede: The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the U.S. Food and Drug Administration amid growing indications she didn’t have the votes needed to win Senate confirmation.
rows: Times Colonist

WASHINGTON (AP) — The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the Food and Drug Administration amid growing indications she didn’t have the votes needed to win Senate confirmation.
CTV News

The White House said Tuesday it has pulled the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to lead the U.S. Food and Drug Administration amid growing indications she didn’t have the votes needed to win Senate confirmation.
CBS News
Heidi Overton, Trump's pick to be FDA commissioner, is having trouble finding enough Republican support to advance her nomination, which could be pulled if she falls short.
Fox News
President Donald Trump's FDA pick, Heidi Overton, saw her nomination pulled one day before a Senate committee vote, a White House official confirmed.
